title: Truncated Out-of-Bag Probability Gain: A Noise-Robust Criterion for Random-Forest Wrapper Feature Selection
abstract: arXiv:2610.29195v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Random-Forest wrapper feature selection can use out-of-bag (OOB) predictions as a built-in validation signal, but the criteria that decide each forward step accumulate OOB estimation noise. We propose TOP-Gain (Truncated Out-of-bag Probability Gain), which scores a candidate feature by the mean sample-level increase in the OOB probability of the true class, with decreases truncated at zero. Under a simple noise model, truncation removes about two-thirds of the noise variance contributed by unaffected samples while preserving the signal, and it makes the ranking of candidate features markedly more reproducible. In a pre-registered benchmark on 26 OpenML-CC18 datasets, TOP-Gain achieved the best mean rank in area under the ROC curve (ROC-AUC), accuracy and Macro-F1 among 15 methods; it was significantly better than 13 of 14 baselines and matched the accuracy of VSURF with 21 times less single-core computation. translated_title: 截断袋外概率增益：一种用于随机森林封装式特征选择的抗噪准则
translated_abstract: 随机森林封装式特征选择可以利用袋外预测作为内置的验证信号，但决定每次前向步骤所选准则会累积袋外估计噪声。我们提出了TOP-Gain（截断袋外概率增益），该方法通过真实类别的袋外概率在样本层面的平均增量来为候选特征评分，并将下降部分截断为零。在一个简单的噪声模型下，截断消除了由未受影响样本贡献的约三分之二的噪声方差，同时保留了信号，并使候选特征的排序显著更具可重复性。在一项针对26个OpenML-CC18数据集的预注册基准测试中，TOP-Gain在15种方法中于ROC曲线下面积（ROC-AUC）、准确率和Macro-F1上均取得了最佳平均排名；它显著优于14个基线方法中的13个，并以少21倍的单核计算量达到了与VSURF相当的准确率。在相同的封装器内，……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出TOP-Gain准则，通过将真实类别袋外概率的下降截断为零来抑制袋外估计噪声，使随机森林封装式特征选择的特征排序更具可重复性，并在26个数据集的预注册基准测试中取得最佳综合表现，且计算效率比VSURF高21倍。
en_tdlr: TOP-Gain is a noise-robust criterion for random-forest wrapper feature selection that truncates negative gains in out-of-bag true-class probability to suppress estimation noise, achieving the best mean rank across ROC-AUC, accuracy, and Macro-F1 on 26 OpenML-CC18 datasets while matching VSURF's accuracy with 21 times less single-core computation.
